RUN |4 PYTORCH_VERSION=2.9.0 TRITON_VERSION= TARGETPLATFORM=linux/amd64 CUDA_VERSION=12.8.1 /bin/sh -c if test -n "${TRITON_VERSION}" -a "${TARGETPLATFORM}" != "linux/arm64"; then         DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt install -y --no-install-recommends gcc;         rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*;     fi # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends         git curl ca-certificates libgl1 libglib2.0-0 ffmpeg     && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c git clone https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI.git /opt/ComfyUI     && cd /opt/ComfyUI     && git checkout ${COMFYUI_REF}     && python -c "import torch; print('torch', torch.__version__, 'cuda', torch.version.cuda)"     && pip install -r requirements.txt # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c cd /tmp     && git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image.git     && mkdir -p /opt/ComfyUI/custom_nodes     && cp -r /tmp/MOSS-Image/comfyui/moss-image /opt/ComfyUI/custom_nodes/moss-image     && rm -rf /tmp/MOSS-Image # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c set -eux;     f=diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors;     curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors       -o "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f"       "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/$f";     test -s "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f" # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c set -eux;     f=text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors;     curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors       -o "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f"       "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/$f";     test -s "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f" # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c set -eux;     f=vae/flux2-vae_small.safetensors;     curl -fL --retry 5 --retry-delay 5 --retry-all-errors       -o "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f"       "https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MOSS-Image/resolve/main/$f";     test -s "/opt/ComfyUI/models/$f" # buildkit

RUN |2 COMFYUI_REF=bef11fcbfa8d772678e2ad00b1294c63eb3e5da7 DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive /bin/sh -c python - <<'PY'
import os
expect = {
  "/opt/ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/moss_image_sft_int8_convrot.safetensors": 5_413_698_958,
  "/opt/ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/qwen3.5_9b_int8_convrot.safetensors": 9_748_121_532,
  "/opt/ComfyUI/models/vae/flux2-vae_small.safetensors": 249_521_340,
}
for path, minimum in expect.items():
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    assert size == minimum, f"{path} is {size} bytes, expected {minimum} (truncated download?)"
    print(f"ok {os.path.basename(path)} {size/2**30:.2f} GiB")
PY # buildkit
